representations.name: divisor interval tiling
representations.new_information: Keeps a fixed interval spectrum while varying scalar-copy step through divisors of U.

representations.name: boundary-gap profile ledger
representations.new_information: Computes normalized source gaps and raw complement gaps on every divisor row.
representations.first_test: Check all values are independent of d>=2.

representations.name: factorial divisor amplifier
representations.new_information: Produces arbitrarily many prescribed divisors d=Se while retaining U<S^2.

representations.name: square-marker common tangent
representations.new_information: Places d^2 inside A_d so one positive tangent is shared by all scalar rows.
representations.first_test: Use rho=1/2,z_d=d and verify d^2=dS*e belongs to A_d.

representations.name: translated tangent positivity
representations.new_information: Adds one common translation large enough to make every tangent parameter positive.
representations.first_test: Choose R0>max d^2+rho^2 and compute T_d.

representations.name: common-tangent distance labels
representations.new_information: Retains the exact target-target squared distance (d-e)^2 on the shared tangent.
representations.first_test: Substitute lambda=d and rho=1/2 in the inherited chart.

representations.name: profile-fibre versus scalar fibre
representations.new_information: Compares a singleton shape-profile fibre with arbitrarily many distinct scalar and target positions.
representations.first_test: Show profile equality does not determine lambda or z.

representations.name: row-count growth audit
representations.new_information: Measures L against U=2S(L!)^2 rather than calling arbitrary size power-large.
representations.first_test: Prove L=U^o(1) and record failure to reach K=t^(5/9-o(1)).

representations.name: selected-core hypothesis firewall
representations.new_information: Separates common-spectrum Euclidean legality from transverse heavy-factor-hub membership.
representations.first_test: Audit centre-leaf coprimality and refuse to infer the power-large selected block.

representations.name: replacement-interface ledger
representations.new_information: Names the extra data needed beyond two boundary gaps to control scalar labels.
representations.first_test: Require interior tiling/factor incidence or a direct lambda-reconstruction lemma.
